camel_example: aliyun live CreateLiveStreamMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --OutputTemplate lp_ud --InputList InputConfig --MonitorName liveMonitor0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'demo.aliyundoc.com'
kebab_example: aliyun live create-live-stream-monitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --monitor-name liveMonitor0000 --output-template lp_ud --domain demo.aliyundoc.com --input-list InputConfig --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLiveStreamMonitor

parameters.help_en: The name of the monitoring session
parameters.name: monitor_name

parameters.help_en:
The output template for the monitoring session. Valid values:

lp_ld: low definition.

lp_sd: standard definition.

lp_hd: high definition.

lp_ud: ultra-high definition
parameters.help_zh:
监播输出模版。类型取值：

lp_ld：流畅。
lp_sd：标清。
lp_hd：高清。
lp_ud：超清
parameters.name: output_template

parameters.help_en: The application name for the output stream of the monitoring session. You can specify a custom name. If you do not specify this parameter, monitor is used as the application name
parameters.help_zh:
监播输出流的App。
名称可自取，不传默认用monitor作为AppName名称
parameters.name: app

parameters.help_en: The name of the output stream for the monitoring session. If you do not specify this parameter, the system generates a random name
parameters.help_zh: 监播输出流名，不传则系统随机生成
parameters.name: stream

parameters.help_en: The list of input streams to monitor. For more information, see the InputConfig table below
parameters.help_zh: 监控流输入列表。具体内容，请参考下表InputConfig
parameters.name: input_list

parameters.help_en: The alert threshold settings for monitoring. The value must be a JSON string. For more information, see the MonitorConfig table below
parameters.help_zh: 监播告警阈值设置，JSON格式，具体内容，请参考下表MonitorConfig
parameters.name: monitor_config

parameters.help_en: The webhook address. HTTP and HTTPS are supported
parameters.help_zh: 支持输入HTTP(S)格式的回调地址
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en:
The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot. To receive alert notifications, configure a DingTalk chatbot and enter its webhook URL, which can be in HTTP or HTTPS format. For more information, see Custom robot access (https://open.dingtalk.com/document/robots/custom-robot-access).

Set the custom keyword for the DingTalk chatbot to "Alerting". Otherwise, you cannot receive messages
parameters.help_zh:
监播钉钉告警通过钉群机器人进行告警信息的通知，请先设置钉群机器人，并在此输入机器人的HTTP(S)地址。详情请参见自定义机器人接入 (https://open.dingtalk.com/document/robots/custom-robot-access)。

配置钉群机器人自定义关键词为“告警”，否则消息无法接收
parameters.name: ding_talk_web_hook_url

MonitorId.description_en: The ID of the monitoring session
